newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX consolidating under 2,800 in near-term.
newsitem.headline: German DAX consolidating under 2,800 in near-term.

text.p: German shares on Monday were expected to consolidate around current levels after their attempt to scale the 2,800 point threshold for the first time late last week, dealers said.
But they admitted that the entry of newly-floated Deutsche Telekom AG into the DAX index on Tuesday would be an unpredictable factor in the future course of the market.

"It shouldn't be that great an effect, but we're all fishing around trying to get an idea of where the share is going," one trader said. German shares on Monday traded 26.45 points lower at 2,774.15 on the IBIS electronic trade system.
The IBIS index had on Friday breached the 2,800 index for the first time, with the DAX cash market just behind, but not quite able to break the psychologically-important barrier.
Deutsche Telekom will constitute around 4.5 percent of the index, trading as the 10th largest DAX stock.
Opinion was split on whether the stock would move ahead any further in the coming days or whether there was now room for it to fall.
In late IBIS trade Telekom shares were quoted at 32.80 marks, 40 pfennigs down on their opening price and well off an a day-high of 34.10 marks on the bourse.
"What you saw earlier was institutions buying to make up for what they didn't get in their allocations, but now that is fading and people are starting to take profits," one said.
Dealers said they were overly concerned that the price of Telekom shares would fall much further, with many seeing support at around 31 marks.
Investment house Trinkaus & Burkhardt issued an investment note suggesting that while the overall market was basically sound, there were "some considerations indicating caution".
"For instance, the technical situation on the German equity market is very overbought," it said in the note.
The investment house said that it did not as a result see any need to raise its 2,850 point medium-term target for the DAX, which earlier on Monday closed 31.96 points down at 2,763.94.
